canonical_incident_record.title: ACB system down in zone 5 at UPS Fort Worth (Haslet); recovery reported after robot 158 was removed from the system
canonical_incident_record.incident_description: A high-priority production-impacting incident was opened for UPS Fort Worth (Haslet) with subject 'ACB System Down.' Source text says the site reported zone 5 was unable to get a pair. Supporting case text says an AMR with low battery was under the rack, the site replaced the AMR, and every AMR went to the hospital. Internal support discussion considered RMS roster/add-remove issues. Later evidence states robot 158 was removed from the system and placed on charger; after that, the system reportedly began functioning again and remained operational during a short monitoring period.
canonical_incident_record.customer_operational_impact: Production was seriously impacted. The reported operational effect was loss of pairing capability in zone 5 and abnormal AMR behavior routing to the hospital lane.
canonical_incident_record.what_resolved_it: Source-supported recovery action was removal of robot 158 from the system, with the robot placed on charger. Case notes then report the system began functioning again and remained operational during approximately 10 minutes of monitoring before the case was resolved and closed.
